messages:
Kevin: Alert - dedicated-us-west1 GPU pool at 98% util, pending queue depth 580, ~90% of requests are low-priority. Autoscaler attempted +4 nodes but failed (quota), evictions starting.
Mira: Noted. Any alerts from cloud quota? Can we spin temporary instances in a different project/region? :eyes:
OncallBot: [ALERT] dedicated-us-west1/gpu-pool util=98% pending=580 autoscale:failed_quota
Sam: I'm on it, checking quota and active evictions. Also checking if routing weights for hosted can absorb low-prio.
Anya: Recommend immediate soft-throttle for low-priority orgs and route to hosted as backfill. Suggest gradual weight shift 90% -> 60% over 10m to avoid latency cliff.
Kevin: Agree. Cost note: hosted backfill will spike egress/compute spend. Ping finance if this looks like >2h sustained.
Raj: I can patch routing via control-plane API, example payload ready. Need run-as header.
Sam: Hold on - add X-Run-As: ops header so change is audited. Also prefer canary script rather than one-shot.
Kevin: Use this command (canary) instead:
```
# canary 10% -> 100% over 12 iterations
redwoodctl routing set --region us-west1 --policy low-priority --canary 0.1 --steps 12
```
Mira: Autoscaler logs show: "insufficient quotas: GPUs". Cloud support ticket CS-4829 opened, no ETA yet.
Anya: Starting canary shift now. Will monitor tail latencies and errors closely. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
OncallBot: [ROUTING CHANGE] user=Anya region=us-west1 policy=low-priority canary=0.1
Sam: After first step p50 hosted increased 40ms -> 48ms, p95 180ms -> 220ms, no error spikes.
Raj: Weight at 30% after 3 iterations, queue depth down to 210. Dedicated evictions stopped.
Kevin: Good. If p95 > 500ms we slow the canary. Also enforce temp hard caps per-org to limit cost exposure.
Mira: Implemented per-org caps for low-prio, config snippet:
```
low_priority_caps:
  org_default: 200 rps
  org_overrides:
    acct-42: 50 rps
```
Sam: Cloud support says quota increase may take 6-8h. Plan for hosted backfill to be the steady state for the window.
Anya: Filed ENGINFRA-867: Improve autoscaler quota fallback and cost alerting. Assigning Sam/Kevin.
Kevin: Thanks — postmortem and cost estimate tomorrow. For now keep canary steady, no more manual shifts.
Diego: (ops) monitoring checks green, no customer-facing errors reported. Will update status page if anything changes.
OncallBot: [RESOLVE] dedicated-us-west1 util now 74% pending=80
Mira: Closing thread; follow-ups assigned to ENGINFRA-867 and COST-312.
